newsitem.title: UK: LB Rheinland-Pfalz plans $500 mln bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: LB Rheinland-Pfalz plans $500 mln bond - dealers.

text.p: Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz plans to issue a $500 million five-year Eurobond this week, syndicate managers said on Monday.
IBJ International was tipped as one of the lead managers but officials there declined to comment. The deal was likely to surface in the latter half of the week.
Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz is rated AA1 by Moody's Investors Service and AA plus by Standard & Poor's. Spread talk for the issue was in the mid-10s basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
An active Euromarket borrower, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz has issued bonds in marks, lira, Swiss francs and yen this year.
